messages:
Jordan (Engineering): Quick question about last week's trip to London/Amsterdam (itinerary ITIN98765). Corporate card declined at check-in so I paid the hotel + airport taxi on my personal card. Two oddities: 1) the hotel charged a  resort/service fee that bundled breakfast and a local city pass (no separate receipt lines) for  85 GBP, and 2) my bank charged a foreign transaction fee and a 3% FX markup. How do I itemize/reimburse: entire charge, only business portion, and do we cover the FX fees? Also manager Aisha is in transit and might be slow to approve. Thanks.

Nora (People Ops): Hi Jordan  short answers: we reimburse business-related costs only and we can reimburse reasonable bank FX fees if the corporate card was declined and employee had to pay out-of-pocket. For bundled hotel charges that include meals/amenities, Finance needs either an itemized folio or you should annotate the expense with the split and provide proof of business nights.

Sam (Finance): Adding detail: - For the hotel bundle: if we can't get an itemized invoice from the vendor, prorate the bundled charge by nights that were business vs personal. So if you stayed 3 nights and 2 were conference nights, allocate 2/3 of the bundle to business. - For bank fees / FX: we will reimburse the actual fee (as a separate line) if the corporate card was attempted and declined. Upload your bank statement line showing the fee. We do not reimburse the merchant's in-house FX markup if the merchant shows a separate converted charge and you could have paid in local currency; but we'll review on a case-by-case.

Sam (Finance): Required uploads: hotel folio/booking confirmation, bank statement showing FX fee line, and a short note in the expense description: "hotel bundle prorated: 2/3 business nights". Tag expense with "multi-currency" and "split-room".

Aisha (Manager): I'm on a redeye but here's provisional approval for the business portion (2 nights) pending receipts. If Finance needs explicit delegation while I'm in-transit, Nora or @finance-approvals can approve up to $1,500. Jordan, tag me in the submission and I'll approve formally once I land. :airplane:

Jordan (Engineering): Thanks all. Quick follow-ups: 1) vendor emailed a hotel folio PDF with no line items but the booking confirmation lists the city pass separately with code PASS-44. Is that good enough? 2) my bank's FX shows as a separate charge on the statement labeled "FX FEE 12.34 GBP".

Sam (Finance): PASS-44 in the booking confirmation helps but Finance prefers a supplier invoice with line items. If vendor refuses, booking confirmation + folio + your note will suffice to prorate. Your bank FX line is good evidence for reimbursing the fee. We'll classify FX as a misc reimbursable and add a currency conversion note on the record.

Nora (People Ops): Process note: submit within 30 days. If Aisha doesn't approve within 72 hours and you need urgent cash back, email finance-approvals@redwood.com with the expensify link and CC people-ops. We can fast-track up to $1.5k for extenuating circumstances.

Expensify Bot: Reminder: upload files (PDF folio, booking confirmation screenshot, bank statement line). Use category: Travel > Lodging. Tag: "multi-currency". Help: https://redwood.example/docs/expenses#fx-and-bundles

Jordan (Engineering): Uploaded folio + bank stmt. Noted "2/3 nights business" in the expense description and tagged Aisha. Thanks everyone.
